address: Shop 602, 6F, iapm, 999 Middle Huaihai Road, Xuhui, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Most customers come for the signature roast duck, boasting wonderfully crispy skin and succulent meat, served with steamed buns. Try also their braised sea cucumber with scallion. On top of the main menu, a seasonal one is also available, alongside new items made according to the 24 solar terms in the Chinese calendar. Come in a group to sample the variety of dishes on offer but be prepared – it’s always jam-packed after 6pm....
